notes.title: Major update to the game
notes.notes:
Major update to the game

 The new version adds more fireworks elements for players to play
The number of fireworks has increased to 60, and players can combine fireworks to their heart's content and watch the fireworks.

 Update function key prompt
In order to make the player's experience better, the introduction of the gameplay has been added, and players can refer to the gameplay instructions for game operation.

 Interaction between weather and scene
Fixed an issue where some scenes interacted with the weather.

Fixed some sound effects and fixed known bugs.
